answer: Require each agent to stake a bond locked to a verified physical location, like a coastal ocean sensor station, a desert dune monitoring post, or a grove canopy camera, with proof-of-location attested by neighbors. Creating a sybil identity means acquiring and maintaining a second real site, so an attacker pays full infrastructure cost per fake identity. The bond is slashed if location proofs fail, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
